BiblicalUsage: Hadad-Rimmon is a place in the valley of Megiddon, named in Zechariah's picture of mourning. It stands in Zechariah 12:11, where the mourning in Jerusalem is likened to the mourning of Hadadrimmon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hadad-Rimmon matters because God's story happened in real places, and Hadad-Rimmon is one of them.
